source: estimate: the fixed-point engine counted on an rv32im model (tools/cpu), calibrated on the factory patches measured on the test rig (2026-11-08)

rig.survey: docs/measurements/cpu-survey-2026-11-08-rig-release-1.11-head.json and -head-run.json (CI run 42462440721), with -2026-11-05-rig-merged-split.json (CI run 42093061899) for the patches changed since

calibration.method: a scale and a fixed time per block, and a factor per factory engine (rig), fitted to the factory patches measured on the test rig (survey, fit)
calibration.survey: docs/measurements/cpu-survey-2026-11-08-rig-release-1.11-head.json and -head-run.json (CI run 42462440721), with -2026-11-05-rig-merged-split.json (CI run 42093061899) for the patches changed since
calibration.fit: rig us = 1.130 x estimate before + 218 us (the 5 patches without an engine of their own: Init, Simple FM, Plucked String, 909 Kit, <7PH), so 233.4 / 1.130 cycles per us plus 1.130 x 23 + 218 us a block; the second core's idle cost 1.130 x 24 us
calibration.acidM102Note: 303 Acid of M1-0.2 (b907693), one note held, peak cycles per block = 12 % of 2901 us (the ISR peak measured on the FM-1): the scale before the survey
calibration.benchNote: firmware/src/bench.c kernels (4x Q15 MAC 9 us, Q15 SVF 8 us per block, rounded down) give the same scale within a few %
calibration.note: module kits hold note 72; a square or saw oscillator costs more the higher it plays
